## Confidence Scoring

See `confidence_scoring.md` for the shared scoring model, output format, and application steps.

### Required Header Fields

| Field | Tier | Deduction |
|-------|------|----------:|
| `invoice_no` | 1 | −15 |
| `invoice_total` | 1 | −15 |
| `supplier_account_no` | 1 | −10 |
| `partner_name` | 1 | −15 |
| `invoice_date` | 1 | −15 |
| `customer_name` | 2 | −10 |
| `po_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `ship_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `delivery_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `customer_address` | 3 | −5 |

> **CSV / Flat File Input — No Deduction:** When the source is a CSV or flat file, an absent `customer_address` carries no deduction and no flag — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §3.12. The −5 above applies to PDF/image input only. This also applies to propane_invoice records and content sub-invoices of a mixed_invoice.

> **Tier 1 fields** also populate `required_fields_missing` when absent and flag the document for manual review — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §15.

### Integrity Checks

| Check | Condition | Deduction |
|-------|-----------|----------:|
| Line total reconciliation | `sum(line_amounts) ≠ invoice_total` | −25 |
| Mixed-sign lines | Invoice contains both positive and negative `line_amount` values — flag `"(-20) mixed_sign_lines — manual review required"` | −20 |
| No product lines | All lines are fee/charge lines — no gas or product lines present. **Waived for General Air (GENERALAIR) content invoices when §17 reconciliation passes** — see note below and Vendor Reference — General Air Service & Supply. | −10 |
| Invalid invoice date | `invoice_date` cannot be parsed as a valid date | −10 |
| EspriGas direct delivery — customer unresolved | Ship-To Exclusion Rule applied (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §1) — no non-EspriGas/TMG customer name could be determined — flag `"(-20) esprigas_direct_delivery — non-EspriGas/TMG customer name could not be determined — manual review required"`. **Does not apply** when Ship-To Name Identification successfully resolved `customer_name` by stripping an EspriGas identifier — that is a correct extraction, not a defect, and carries no deduction. | −20 |

> **General Air — No Product Lines Override:** For General Air (GENERALAIR) content invoices, do not apply the "No product lines" −10 deduction, provided §17 line total reconciliation passes (`sum(line_amounts) = invoice_total`, no line total mismatch). If reconciliation fails, apply both the line total reconciliation deduction (−25) and the No product lines deduction (−10) as normal — the waiver only covers invoices where the numbers genuinely tie out. See Vendor Reference — General Air Service & Supply.

> **Propane Split Customer — No Product Lines Override:** When a §14.1 Propane Split Customer's invoice contains only propane lines, the resulting Content Invoice record (produced by the split) legitimately has zero lines and a $0.00 total. Do not apply the "No product lines" −10 deduction to that empty Content Invoice record — this is the expected, correct outcome of the split, not an extraction gap. The companion Propane Invoice record is scored normally (it has product lines and is not affected by this waiver). **The reverse is equally normal** — a listed customer's invoice with only content lines produces an empty Propane Invoice record (`lines: []`, `invoice_total: 0`) that carries the same waiver, for the same reason.

> **`esprigas_item_no` type digit check does not apply to content invoices** — content invoices never run §13.8 scheme construction (see §13.4 Step 4's Content Invoice exception), and the output value is always `""` regardless (see "`esprigas_item_no` — Always Empty"). This check still applies internally to Rental Invoices — see that extractor's own Confidence Scoring section.

### Minor Flags

| Check | Condition | Deduction |
|-------|-----------|----------:|
| Ship date defaulted | `ship_date` had no header field, no table date (§15.5a), and no order/PO date (§15.5) to fall back to — set to `invoice_date` via the true-default path (field description Step 4). **Does not apply** when `ship_date` was derived from a table date or an order/PO date fallback — those cases carry their own `(0)` informational flag instead (§15.5a, §15.5) and are not defaults for scoring purposes. | −3 |
| Assumed even exchange | At least one line on the document has `qty_returned_provenance == "defaulted"`. Read this field directly — **never infer provenance by comparing `qty_returned` to `qty_shipped`**; a matching printed count is `"stated"`, not an assumption. Does not fire when every line's `qty_returned_provenance` is `"stated"` or `"not_applicable"` (bulk gas / hardgoods purchase lines). **Apply once per document, flat** — do not multiply by the number of affected lines. Flag `"(-5) qty_returned_assumed_even_exchange"`. | −5 flat (per document, not per line) |
| Missing optional field | `order_no` or `ship_via` **absent** | −2 per field |

**`customer_po_number` is exempt from any deduction when absent.** Many suppliers do not print an end-customer PO reference at all — leaving it blank is expected, not an extraction gap. Do not add a flag or deduction for this field under any circumstance.

**Never deduct "Missing optional field" for a field that is present.** This check fires only on absence. A populated `order_no` or `ship_via` — regardless of its value — must never trigger this or any other deduction. There is no rule anywhere in this framework that penalizes a field for being present; if a flag naming a present field's value appears (e.g., `"ship_via: OUR TRUCK present"`), it is invalid and must not be produced.

**`order_no` is exempt from the "Missing optional field" deduction for General Air (GENERALAIR) content invoices.** General Air's content invoices never print an order/shipping-order number field — its absence is expected for this vendor, not an extraction gap. Do not add a flag or deduction for `order_no` on General Air content invoices; `ship_via` absence is unaffected and still deducts normally. See Vendor Reference — General Air Service & Supply.

### Example — Invoice 0000348969 (Tech-Gas Solutions)

All required fields present, line total reconciles (990.81 = 990.81), ship date extracted from Shipping Order column. **Score: 100 — Label: HIGH — Flags: []**

---

## Post-Processing Reference — Arithmetic Derivations

> The rules in this section are **not applied during extraction**. They document arithmetic computations performed by post-processing code after the model output is received. Preserved here for developer reference.

### Item_Price Derivation — Vendors That Do Not Print Unit Price

`item_price = round(line_amount / qty, N)` where N is vendor-specific precision.

| Vendor | Rounding | Notes |
|--------|----------|-------|
| MEDICAL OXYGEN | 3 decimal places | Matched on seller name |
| CLINICAL (seller contains "clinical") | 3 decimal places | |
| MACCARB | 3 decimal places | Also handles tier discounts — see below |
| AIRGAS DRY ICE | 5 decimal places | Non-rental; formatted `.5f` |
| T & T AIR | 3 decimal places | |
| FERRELLGAS | 4 decimal places | Non-rental and rental; also has Qty multiplier |
| PARACO / PARACO GAS | 3 decimal places | |

### Qty Derivation — Vendors That Do Not Print Quantity

| Vendor | Formula | Notes |
|--------|---------|-------|
| ROADRUNNER | `int(round(line_amount / item_price))` | Non-rental |
| MESSER | `round(line_amount / item_price, 2)` — keep decimal | Non-rental |
| MATHESON (non-rental) | Extracted from description text — see below | |
| AIRGAS DRY ICE | Use Qty from first row for all lines | Hazmat lines: Qty = 1 |

### MACCARB — Tier Discount Row Handling

1. Identify rows where `item_no` contains `"tier discount"` (case-insensitive).
2. Extract the discount amount from `line_amount` — handle `$`, parentheses, and leading `-`.
3. Subtract the discount from the immediately preceding row's `line_amount`.
4. Remove the Tier Discount row entirely.
5. After adjustment: `item_price = line_amount / qty`.

### FERRELLGAS — Propane Exchange Qty Multiplier

For item `"EXCH_33LB_AL_I_L"`: multiply extracted `qty` by 8 (converts exchange units to pounds). Then `item_price = round(line_amount / qty, 4)`.

### AIRGAS DRY ICE — Qty Applied Across All Rows

- If `item_no` matches `"hazmat"`, `"hazcharge"`, or `"handling"` (case-insensitive): `qty = 1`
- All other lines: `qty = first_row_qty`
- `item_price = round(line_amount / qty, 5)` formatted to 5 decimal places.

### MATHESON — Non-Rental Qty and Price from Description Text

- **Item_Price:** Match pattern `@ *[\d.]+ */[\w\s]*100CF` — extract the number between `@` and `/`.
- **Qty:** Match `(\d+)\sCF\s@` to get total CF, then `/\s*([\d]+)\s*CF` to get unit size. `Qty = total_CF / unit_CF`.
- Example: `"200 CF @ 12.50 /100CF"` → Price = 12.50, Qty = 2.

---
---
---
# SOURCE: rent_invoice_extraction_v1.70.md
---

# Rent Invoice — Extraction Logic
**Version:** 1.71
**Model Target:** claude-sonnet-5-5
**Min Token Estimate:** ~6,400
**Cache Strategy:** explicit
**Last Updated:** 2026-09-23

---

## Purpose

Extracts structured data from vendor Cylinder Rental Invoices submitted to EspriGas. These invoices bill EspriGas for cylinders on site at a customer location. Organized into rental groups (LRG, SML, VGL, HPS, MSM, NXG). Billed either Monthly (M) or Daily (D/DP).

**Key identifiers:** Header says `"CYLINDER RENTAL INVOICE"`. Has columns for BEGINNING BALANCE, SHIPPED, RETURNED, ENDING BALANCE, DAYS (if daily), CYLINDER RATE, EXTENDED AMOUNT.

**Multi-document / Mixed PDF handling:** A single PDF file may contain multiple distinct documents — either different document types across pages, or multiple documents of the same type. Treat each distinct document independently:
- Classify each page independently. If a page is identified as a Content Invoice, route it to the Content Invoice extractor.
- When a PDF contains multiple rental invoices, produce a separate extraction output for each.

**Credit Memo routing:** Before applying any rental invoice extraction rules, check for credit memo signals. If the invoice total is negative, carries a `CR` suffix (e.g., `151.91 CR`), or the document header or a label directly above the line items contains `"CREDIT MEMO"`, `"CREDIT NOTE"`, or `"CREDIT INVOICE"`, reclassify as a Credit Memo and route to `credit_memo_extraction.md`. Do not extract as a Rental Invoice.

**Mixed Invoice routing:** If both Content lines and Rental lines appear under a single invoice number (not on separate pages with separate invoice numbers), that document is a Mixed Invoice — route to `mixed_invoice_extraction.md`. Rental lines within a Mixed Invoice are extracted under that file's rules, not this one.

---

## Rental vs. Content Classification

Use the following signals to confirm a page IS a Rental Invoice. Check all patterns case-insensitively.

| Signal Type | Text / Field Value | Vendors |
|-------------|-------------------|---------|
| `"cylinder rental invoice"` in page text | Raw text | LAMPTON, SIDNEYLEE, GEERGAS, JACKSONWEL, VERNLEWIS, MCKINNEY, STARWELD, WELDSERVICE, MINNEAPOLIS, LOUISINA, WESTCOOP, UNITEDWELDING, NEARUCO2, ATLAS, PACIFICWELD, SYOXSA, AIRGASNATIONAL, IRISHCARBONIC, MAINOXY, AIRWELD, AWISCOCORP, DMI, JONESWELDING, AIRSUPPLY, HELGET, CWSUPPLY, INDIANAOXY, BJWELDING, OEMEYER, MATHESON |
| `"cylinder"` AND `"rental"` both present | Raw text | HOLSTON |
| `"rental invoice"` in page text | Raw text | BECKLEYRENT, SKYOXYGEN, JMGASES |
| `"rent days"` in page text | Raw text | COASTALCARB, ROCKYMOUNT, AWI |
| `"monthly rental"` in page text | Raw text | ANALGESIC, MAVERICK |
| `"rental"` anywhere in page text | Raw text | ADVANCEDGAS, DELILLE, JMCYLINDER, SJSMITH, CESCO (uses `"telemetry"` instead) |
| PO Number field = `"RENTAL"` | Header field | SOUTHEASTERN |
| PO Number field = `"MONTHLY EQ"` | Header field | PREMIERMEDL |
| Comment/Route field = `"RENT"` | Header field | MAVERICK, UNITEDWELDING |
| Route/descriptor = `"Rent"` (capitalized) | Header field | AMERIGAS, PHILADELPHIA |
| Route/descriptor = `"cylinder rental"` | Header field | GENERALAIR |
| Route/descriptor = `"rental detail and description"` | Header field | PRAXLINDT |
| `"group bill"` in page header text AND `"O2TANKRENTAL"` item code in section lines | Raw text | NUCARA |

**Default:** If none of the above match and the page shows group/balance columns rather than product lines, treat as Rental Invoice.

**Fee lines:** Rental invoices commonly include flat fee lines (e.g., cylinder management fees, HRCM charges). The presence of fee lines does not affect invoice classification — classify as Rental Invoice regardless.

---

## Extraction Rules

### Bill-To vs. Ship-To

`customer_name` and `customer_address` always refer to the Ship-To (end customer location, or EspriGas store for internally-held cylinders). `supplier_account_no` is EspriGas's account with the vendor. For EspriGas entity identification and the Ship-To Exclusion Rule, see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §1. **When the document prints more than the usual two address blocks** (e.g., a top-row `SHIP FROM` next to a `BILL TO`, or a bottom-row `BILL TO` next to the `SHIP TO`), extract all of them per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26 — do not discard the extras.

### Header Fields

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `partner_name` | Vendor/supplier name as printed on the invoice. **CSV/flat-file input with no vendor-name column: apply §3.11** — use the same value resolved for `trade_partner` below, instead of leaving this Tier 1 field absent. |
| `supplier_account_no` | EspriGas's account with the vendor. When a dedicated account number field is present in the invoice header, use it. When no dedicated header account field is present but the invoice shows separate **Bill To Acct #** and **Ship To Acct #** fields, prefer the **Ship To Acct #** unless a vendor-specific rule states otherwise. |
| `supplier_name` / `supplier_address` | The vendor's remit-to entity name and address — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §19. Omit both entirely when neither a remit-to block nor a general vendor address appears on the document. |
| `ship_from_name` / `ship_from_address` | The vendor's shipping-origin branch/warehouse, from a `SHIP FROM` block (typically paired with a top-row `BILL TO`) — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26. Omit both entirely when no `SHIP FROM` block appears on the document. |
| `bill_to_name` / `bill_to_address` | The billed customer's (EspriGas's) name and address, from a `BILL TO` block — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26. Omit both entirely when no such block appears on the document. |
| `invoice_no` | Vendor-assigned invoice number |
| `invoice_date` | Date on the invoice header |
| `invoice_total` | Total dollar amount |
| `terms` | Payment terms, normalized. Labels vary: `TERMS`, `PAYMENT TERMS`, `NET TERMS`. Normalize numeric day terms by stripping `DAYS`/`DAY` and prepending `NET ` (e.g., `45 DAYS` → `NET 45`, `NET 30 DAYS` → `NET 30`). Keep as-is: `COD`, `DUE ON RECEIPT`, `PREPAID`, `EOM`. Leave blank if absent. |
| `due_date` | Invoice due date. Extract directly if stated on document. Otherwise calculate from `invoice_date` + net days (parsed from normalized `terms`). For `COD`, `DUE ON RECEIPT`, `PREPAID`: use `invoice_date`. Leave blank if terms are absent or non-calculable. |
| `customer_name` | Ship-To name (end customer or EspriGas location) |
| `customer_address` | Ship-To address — split into `address_1`, `address_2`, `city`, `state`, `zip` |
| `buyer_code` | Vendor-printed code for the buying entity, branch, or division. Labels vary: `BUYER CODE`, `BRANCH`, `DIVISION`, `DEPT`, `SOLD-TO CODE`. **Do not restate `supplier_account_no` here.** Always present in output; empty string when absent. No confidence deduction. See GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §25. |
| `shipto_code` | Vendor-printed code for the ship-to location. Labels vary: `SHIP-TO CODE`, `SHIP TO NO.`, `LOCATION`, `SITE`, `ROUTE`, `WAREHOUSE`, `SHIP TO ACCT #`. When separate Bill-To and Ship-To account numbers are printed, the ship-to value goes here. **Do not restate `supplier_account_no`.** Always present in output; empty string when absent. No confidence deduction. See GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §25. |
| `trade_partner` | **CSV/flat-file input: check §3.10 first** — if the file has a `TradePartner` column, use its value directly (Priority 1); else if the filename carries a `<TradePartner>_` prefix, use that value directly (Priority 2); either way, do not run the lookup below. Otherwise: BC trade partner code for the supplier. Look up `partner_name` (case-insensitive) in the Trade Partner Reference table (§TP.2). If found and not listed in §TP.1, use the mapped code. If listed in §TP.1, output `INSTANTLRN` and flag per §TP rules. If no match found, output `INSTANTLRN`. |
| `content_type` | Short-form record type — **derived from `document_type`, never read from the document** (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §20). Rental invoices are always `Rent`. Always populated. No confidence deduction. |
| `customer_po_number` | **Placeholder — always output as empty string. Do not extract from document.** Rental invoices do not carry PO numbers. |
| `po_date` | Last day of the invoice billing period when stated on the document. Look for labels such as `Billing Period`, `Service Period`, `Period`, `Period Ending`, `Thru`, `Through`, or a date range in the invoice header — extract the **end date** of that range. If no billing period is indicated, default to `invoice_date`. Always populated in output. |
| `order_no` | **Placeholder — always output as empty string. Do not extract from document.** Rental invoices do not carry order numbers. |
| `ship_date` | Always = `invoice_date` — no document lookup required. Always populated in output. |
| `delivery_date` | Always = `invoice_date` — no document lookup required. Always populated in output. |
| `comment` | Text following a literal `Comment:` label anywhere on the document. See GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §28. **Omit entirely when no `Comment:` label is present.** |
| `additional_header_fields` | Any other labeled header field printed on the document that isn't captured by a field above — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §27. **Omit entirely when none found** — no confidence deduction. |

> **Shipment-related fields do not apply to rental invoices.** A cylinder rental bills a period of possession, not a delivery event, so there is no shipment to describe. Omit all of the following entirely — do not write `null` or empty strings: `care_of` (§21), `is_rush` / `delivered_by` (§23, see the §23.4 applicability matrix), and `delivery_note_no` / `bill_of_lading_no` (§24, see the §24.4 applicability matrix).
>
> **`buyer_code` and `shipto_code` are the exception** — those two *do* apply to rental invoices, because they identify the account and location rather than a delivery event. See §25.5.

### Rental Group Structure

Each rental invoice groups cylinders by **Rent Group code**:

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| LRG | Large Cylinders |
| SML | Small Cylinders |
| VGL | VGL Dewars (large liquid dewars) |
| HPS | Small High Pressure |
| MSM | Med D & E cylinders |
| NXG | NX-Gen / Oxytote cylinders |

Within each group, multiple **item types** (cylinder species) may be present. The group TOTALS row shows the aggregate ending balance, rate, and extended amount for the group.

**Fallback:** If a vendor's invoice does not print a rental group header, leave `rent_group` blank. Do not attempt to derive it from the item description.

### Rent Method Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| M | Monthly |
| MD | Monthly Demurrage |
| D | Daily |
| DD | Daily Demurrage |
| PD / DP | Peak Daily |
| PM | Peak Monthly |
| R | Regular (Geer Gas convention — functionally monthly) |

### Unit Price Derivation

**Monthly invoices:** Unit Price is stated directly as the Cylinder Rate on the TOTALS row.
Verify: `Ending Balance × Rate = Extended Amount`.

**Monthly invoices with a BAL/DAYS column:** When a monthly invoice (rent method R or M) prints a `BAL/DAYS` or `BALANCE` column, treat that column value as the **ending balance (cylinder count)** — not cylinder-days. Apply Check 1 (Ending Balance × Rate = Extended Amount). Do not apply the cylinder-days fallback (Check 3).

**Daily invoices:** The stated Cylinder Rate is the **total group rate per day** (not per cylinder). To get the per-cylinder unit price for the billing period:

```
Unit Price (per cylinder, full period) = Extended Amount ÷ Ending Balance
```

Verify: `Ending Balance × Unit Price = Extended Amount`.

**Daily invoices — BAL/DAYS format:** Some vendors print a cylinder-days column (labeled `BAL/DAYS`, `BALANCE`, or `CYLINDER DAYS`) instead of a plain cylinder count. When the ending balance is present, run the three-step pricing check below in order to determine `unit_price`.

**When the TOTALS row explicitly states the ending balance**, apply checks in this order — stop at the first that passes:

> **Check 1 — Monthly rate:** Does `ending_balance × stated_rate = extended_amount` (within rounding tolerance)?
> - **Passes** → `qty = ending_balance`, `unit_price = stated_rate`.
>
> **Check 2 — Daily rate × full month:** Does `ending_balance × stated_rate × days_in_invoiced_month = extended_amount` (within rounding tolerance)?
> - `days_in_invoiced_month` = actual calendar days in the month on the invoice date (e.g., 31 for May, 28/29 for February).
> - **Passes** → `qty = ending_balance`, `unit_price = stated_rate × days_in_invoiced_month`.
> - This applies when all cylinders in a group were on site for the full month with no mid-period movements.
>
> **Check 3 — Cylinder-days math (fallback):** Neither check above passed.
> - Extended amount was derived as `cylinder-days × rate` with pro-rated activity mid-period.
> - Use `qty = ceil(cylinder_days ÷ 31)`, `unit_price = round(Extended Amount ÷ qty, 3)`.

**When ending balance is absent or ambiguous** (cylinder count cannot be determined from the document):
```
qty        = ceil(cylinder-days ÷ 31)    [always 31, regardless of actual days in the month]
unit_price = Extended Amount ÷ qty
```

Verify: `qty × unit_price = Extended Amount`.

### Multi-Cylinder-Type Breakdown

When a rental group contains multiple item types, the TOTALS row aggregates them. **Break these out into one line per item type:**

1. Identify each item listed above the TOTALS row within the group.
2. Read each item's individual ending balance from its transaction rows.
3. Apply the group's rate to each item's ending balance.
4. Use the **final-line remainder method** to ensure per-item amounts sum exactly to the group TOTALS extended amount (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §17.3):
   - All items except the last: `line_amount = round(qty × unit_price, 2)`
   - Last item in the group: `line_amount = group_total − sum(preceding line_amounts)`

**Example — Invoice 0003018714, LRG group (46 cyl total):**
```
MAIKH  (Med Air SZ KH)        :  8 cyl × $5.06 = $ 40.48
MOXK   (Med O2 Size K)        : 16 cyl × $5.06 = $ 80.96
MOXOXY (Med O2 Oxytote)       : 22 cyl × $5.06 = $111.32
                               ─────────────────────────
LRG TOTAL                     : 46 cyl           $232.76 ✓
```

### Negative Ending Balances

A cylinder type can have a negative ending balance when more were returned during the period than are on record as being out. Treat as a negative quantity line (credit). The math still applies: negative qty × rate = negative amount reduces the group total.

**Example:** Invoice 0003018858, MLO230 in VGL group ended at -1 cylinder.

### Rental Line Fields

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `item_no` | Vendor item code + `-R` suffix (see Rental-Specific Extraction Rules below) |
| `description` | Product description. Extract when available; leave blank if absent. |
| `qty` | Ending balance (cylinder count for the billing period) |
| `unit_price` | Per-cylinder price for the billing period |
| `line_amount` | Extended amount (qty × unit_price) |
| `rent_group` | Group code: LRG, SML, VGL, HPS, MSM, NXG |
| `rent_method` | M, D, DP, MD, DD, PM, R |
| `esprigas_item_no` | Always written as an empty string (`""`) — placeholder for EspriGas item#, populated in a later step, not resolved by Rosetta. Internally, (1) fee mapping table (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §18), (2) cross-reference lookup, and (3) scheme construction (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.8) still feed other rules (e.g. `is_rush`) — none of that is written here. See GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.4. If `item_no` truncation is ever approved, the `-R` suffix must be preserved — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.3 |

### Quantity Columns — Extraction Rule

For all rental invoices, `qty` is sourced exclusively from the **ENDING BALANCE** column. All other quantity-related columns — including BEGINNING BALANCE, SHIPPED, RETURNED, and any vendor-specific columns (e.g., LEASED CYLINDERS, RENTAL DAYS) — are informational and must not be extracted. `qty_returned` is always zero for rental line items and is not included in the rental output schema.

Integrity check: `qty × unit_price = line_amount`. If this does not hold, flag the line. **Exception:** the last item in a multi-type group uses the final-line remainder method — a small discrepancy from `qty × unit_price` is expected and must not be flagged (see Multi-Cylinder-Type Breakdown step 4).

### Zero-Dollar Line Filtering

**Global rule:** Rental line items with a $0.00 extended amount are omitted from output. This applies to all vendors on rental invoices.

> This rule covers rental cylinder lines and rental fee lines only. It does not govern content line items on content invoices.

### Email / Communication Page Detection

Skip pages that are email forwarding headers. When a page contains all three of `"from"`, `"to"`, and `"sent"` in close proximity, treat the page as non-extractable and move to the next page.

**Exception — never skip for:** SJSMITH, MESSER, CARBONICSERVICES, 079056347.

---

## Rental-Specific Extraction Rules

### Item_No Transformations

Apply GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME §13.3 normalization pipeline. Rental-specific steps for §13.3 Step 3:
- **Append `-R` suffix** — strip any existing trailing `-R` or `- R` first to avoid doubling
- **Truncate** to 20 characters (preserve `-R`: truncate base to 18 chars, reattach `-R`)

**Vendors without a printed product code** — derive `item_no` from the description field: apply ChangeAbbreviation, remove spaces, truncate to the vendor-specific limit, then append `-R`:

| Vendor | Char Limit |
|--------|-----------|
| ADVANCED GAS | 25 |
| HARRIS INDUSTRIAL | 20 |
| MAVERICK | 15 |
| MEDOX CORPORATION | 25 |
| MITCHELL WELDING | 20 |
| ORANGE COAST | 20 |
| SPECTRUM GAS | 20 |
| STOODY INDUSTRIAL | 25 |
| SYOXSA | 20 |
| WESTCO | 25 |

On rental invoices, the Cyl_Returned, Cyl_Shipped, Qty_Ordered, and Computations columns are not extracted.

### Environment / Compliance Fee Row Handling

For rows where Description contains both `"ENVIRONMENT"` and `"COMPLI"`:
- Set `item_no = "ENV"` (before appending -R suffix)
- If both `line_amount` and `item_price` are present and numeric: `qty = line_amount / item_price`

Rows containing `"HMRC"` in Description: `item_no = "FEE"` with same qty derivation.

### Item_Price Derivation — Rental Vendors That Do Not Print Unit Price

Derive: **`item_price = round(line_amount / qty, N)`**

| Vendor | Rounding | Notes |
|--------|----------|-------|
| ADVANCED GAS | 3 decimal places | Also derives Item_No — see below |
| AWISCOCORP | 3 decimal places | |
| WESCO | 3 decimal places | |
| HAUN (HAUNWELDING) | 3 decimal places | Two-pass: price first, then qty |
| AIRTEC GASES | 3 decimal places | |
| MINNEAPOLIS OXYGEN | 3 decimal places | |
| ORANGE COAST | 3 decimal places | Also derives Item_No |
| SPECTRUM GAS | 3 decimal places | Also derives Item_No |
| MITCHELL WELDING | 3 decimal places | Also derives Item_No and Qty |
| MATHESON (rental) | 3 decimal places | |
| T & T AIR | 3 decimal places | |
| AGL | 3 decimal places | |
| GENERAL AIR SERVICE | 4 decimal places | Formatted `.4f` |
| YOUNG WELDING | 3 decimal places | |
| SYOXSA | 3 decimal places | Also derives Item_No |
| CM2 SUPPLY | 3 decimal places | |
| EUREKA OXYGEN | 3 decimal places | Formatted `.2f` output |
| KOOL GAS | 3 decimal places | Formatted `.2f` output |
| AIR SUPPLY | 2 decimal places | Formatted `.2f` |
| O.E. MEYER | 2 decimal places | Formatted `.2f` |
| NORCO | 3 decimal places | |
| CENTRAL MCGOWAN | 2 decimal places | Formatted `.2f` |

### Qty Derivation — Rental Vendors That Do Not Print Quantity

| Vendor | Formula |
|--------|---------|
| AIRGAS | `int(round(line_amount / item_price))` |
| HAUN (second pass) | `int(round(line_amount / item_price))` — skip rows where item_price=0 or line_amount=0 |
| MITCHELL WELDING | `int(round(line_amount / item_price))` |
| HARRIS INDUSTRIAL | `int(round(line_amount / item_price))` |

### Description Fallback

When the Description field is absent or blank on any rental invoice line, set:

`Description = Item_No value`

This ensures a meaningful description is present on every line for BC import.

### Tag-Line Invoice Format

Some vendors structure rental invoices with individual cylinder-level transaction rows (ship/return events, tag IDs, serial numbers, dates) followed by a group TOTALS row that aggregates all cylinders in the group. When this format is present:

- **Skip all individual transaction rows** — they are an audit trail only. Do not extract values from them.
- **Extract all values exclusively from the TOTALS row** for each cylinder group.

**Identifying signals:**
- Individual rows contain per-unit identifiers (tag ID, serial number, delivery date, ship/return details)
- A summary TOTALS row follows each group (labeled `TOTALS`, `—— TOTALS ——>`, or similar)

**Cylinder-days column:** The column label varies by vendor (`BAL/DAYS`, `BALANCE`, or `CYLINDER DAYS`) — see each vendor section for their specific label. Apply the BAL/DAYS pricing check to derive `qty` and `unit_price`.

**Multi-page invoices:** When intermediate pages show `CONTINUED` or `INVOICE AMOUNT: CONTINUED`, do not attempt to sum from those pages. Read through to the final page to find the invoice total and complete TOTALS rows.

### Vendor-Specific Rules

#### INDIANA OXYGEN CO. (INDIANAOXY)

- **ITEM column format:** The ITEM column concatenates item code and description as `CODE - DESCRIPTION` (e.g., `CD50RB - CARBON DIOXIDE - 50 LB 437 CF`). Split on the first ` - ` delimiter: use the first segment as `item_no`; use the remainder as `description`.
- **supplier_account_no:** Use the CUSTOMER field value (e.g., `24561`).
- **rent_method:** M — billed monthly; CYLINDER RATE is the monthly per-cylinder rate.
- **LEASED CYLINDERS column:** Informational only. Do not extract.
- **RENTAL DAYS column:** Informational only — shows total cylinder-days (ending balance × calendar days in period), not a billing day count. Do not use for price derivation.

#### B&J Welding Supply LLC (BJWELDING)

- **EspriGas Account:** CUSTOMER field value (e.g., `9009`)
- **Rent method:** D (daily) — BAL/DAYS format; apply the BAL/DAYS pricing check and Tag-Line Invoice Format rule above
- **INV TYPE column:** `R` = rental cylinder group; `F` = fee line — informational only, does not map to `rent_method`
- **BALANCE FORWARD \*N:** The count `*N` at the end of each item's tag-line section is the ending balance for that item type. Use these counts for the multi-cylinder-type breakdown; apply the group `unit_price` uniformly across types

#### CARBONIC SERVICE INC — Rental Item_No Logic

If Item_No = `"2514"` or `"2514-R"`: new Item_No = first 4 chars of original + first 4 chars of Description (cleaned).
Example: `"2514"` + `"CARB"` = `"2514CARB"` → then append -R suffix → `"2514CARB-R"`.

#### O.E. Meyer Co. (OEMEYER)

- **Account number:** Customer field on invoice header (e.g., `56263`)
- **Rent method:** D (daily) — BAL/DAYS format; **BALANCE column = cylinder-days**; apply Tag-Line Invoice Format rule above
- **Fee lines:** F-type lines (e.g., ACM — Cylinder Management Fee) are flat fees — include unless $0.00.

#### Air Supply of North Texas (AIRSUPPLY)

- **EspriGas Accounts:** 17608, 17754 (and others)
- **Rent method:** D (daily) — BAL/DAYS format; **BALANCE column = cylinder-days**; apply Tag-Line Invoice Format rule above
- **Partial-period invoices:** Air Supply may invoice mid-period when a large delivery occurs. Cylinder-days reflect fewer than 31 days; always prefer ending balance from TOTALS row over the ÷31 fallback.
- **Item_Price:** Derived at 2 decimal places: `round(line_amount / qty, 2)`.

#### Nippon Sanso Matheson Inc. (MATHESON)

> **NIPPON SANSO invoices:** Invoices branded as NIPPON SANSO (or any variation of that name) follow all rules in this section. Apply MATHESON extraction logic regardless of which brand name appears on the invoice header.

- **EspriGas Accounts:** U9869 (East Texas EMS-Tyler), U9880 (East Texas EMS-Athens)
- **Rent method:** D (daily) — **CYLINDER DAYS column = cylinder-days**; apply Tag-Line Invoice Format rule above
- **CYLINDER DAYS column:** Explicitly labeled in invoice header. Rate column is a per-cylinder-day rate.
- **MTG group (Customer Owned):** Tracked at $0.00 — omit per global $0.00 rental line rule.
- **Fee lines:** F-type lines (e.g., TRG — HRCM 400 CYLMGMTFEE) are flat fees — include unless $0.00.

##### Per-Cylinder-Type Extraction

Each rental group (e.g., HPM, RM, SM) contains individual cylinder type sub-rows plus a TOTALS row. Extract **one output line per cylinder type (item code)** within each group — do not collapse a group into a single line.

**Source columns per group:**
- **TOTALS row:** provides `group_ending_balance` (End column), `group_cylinder_days` (CYLINDER DAYS), `group_daily_rate` (Rate column), `group_amount` (Amount column)
- **Individual cylinder type sub-rows:** each shows the ending balance (End column) for that cylinder type — use as `qty` for that output line

**Amount derivation:**
```
unit_price  = round(group_amount / group_ending_balance, 3)    ← same for all items in group (uniform daily rate)
line_amount = round(qty × unit_price, 2)                        ← all items except the last in the group
line_amount = group_amount − sum(preceding line_amounts)         ← last item in group (final-line remainder)
```

The final line's `line_amount` may differ from `round(qty × unit_price, 2)` by a few cents. This is expected — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §17.3.

#### Haun Welding Supply Inc. (HAUNWELDING)

Standard content invoices use the ITEM column format (see `content_invoice_extraction.md`). Rental invoices use the nested NOTE format described below.

##### Billing Code Table (140~X Format)

| Code | Description | Treatment |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| 140~1 | Standard cylinder rental | Rental line — extract cylinder detail from NOTE sub-section |
| 140~MED | Small medical cylinder rental | Rental line — extract cylinder detail from NOTE sub-section |
| 140~365 | Cylinder days beyond 365 surcharge | Fee line — include; `esprigas_item_no = 930020` |
| 140~REQ | Cylinder maintenance & requalification | Fee line — typically $0.00; omit per global $0.00 rule |

##### Nested NOTE Format — Cylinder Count Extraction

Haun rental invoices list each billing group as a single line item (day count, rate, extended amount). Cylinder type and count detail appears in a `NOTE:` sub-section beneath each billing line.

1. Aggregate all cylinder type/count pairs from the NOTE sub-section by type. Sub-account lines (e.g., `0001 - CUSTOMER NAME`) partition entries within the NOTE section but do not create separate billing groups — aggregate all cylinder entries across any sub-account dividers.
2. Apply BAL/DAYS Check 2: `ending_balance × stated_rate × days_in_invoiced_month = extended_amount`.
3. Produce one output line per cylinder type, with `unit_price = stated_rate × days_in_invoiced_month`.
4. `item_no` = NOTE cylinder type code + `-R` suffix (e.g., `100OXM220-R`).
5. `description` = billing line description + ` — ` + cylinder type code (e.g., `Cylinder Rental — 100OXM220`).

- **Invoice format:** "CYLINDER RENTAL INVOICE" with BAL/DAYS column
- **Rent method:** R (regular/monthly)

- **Customer:** Southwest Ohio Dialysis #1541/Davit (215 S. Allison Ave., Xenia OH 45385)

### Helget Gas Products (HELGET)
- **Item code format:** Printed as two space-separated tokens — a gas-type prefix and a number (e.g. `"O2 34742"`). **Capture both tokens as `item_no`** — do not drop the gas-type prefix and capture only the trailing number. After Item_No Transformations' `-R` suffix (above): `item_no = "O2 34742-R"`.
  > **Corrected 2026-10-02:** Extraction had been capturing only the number (e.g. `34742` instead of `O2 34742`), per Chris Farmer's review.
- **Space handling exception:** Per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.3 Step 2, do **not** remove the space between the two tokens — this is a documented, named exception to the otherwise-unconditional space-removal step.

### nexAir, LLC (NEXAIR)
- **EspriGas Account:** Customer # field on invoice header (e.g., L3041)
- **Bill-To:** TMG Gases Inc / EspriGas, 1718 Briarcrest Dr Ste 100, Bryan TX 77802-2779
- **Rent method:** R (Regular/Monthly)
- **Fee lines:** TCF (Supply Chain Impact) is a flat billable fee — include it. ACM (Cylinder Control Tec) and CLR (Cylinder Maintenance) appear at $0.00 — exclude them.
- **Invoice format:** Also submitted as a CSV/flat-file export — one row per line item, multiple invoices grouped by invoice number within a single file. Apply GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §3 CSV / Flat File Processing rules.

#### CSV Format

| CSV Column Header | Schema Field | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `TradePartner` | `trade_partner` / `partner_name` | Present in this format — Priority 1 per §3.10/§3.11; use directly, verbatim |
| `Invoice_Number` | `invoice_no` | Group key — all rows sharing this value form one invoice; apply §13.6 normalization |
| `Invoice_Date` | `invoice_date` | Stored as an Excel date serial (e.g., `46295`) — convert per §3.5 before normalizing (`46295` → `2026-09-30`) |
| `Branch` | `buyer_code` | Nexair's internal branch/division code |
| `CUSNO` | `supplier_account_no` | EspriGas's account number with Nexair for that customer |
| `Ship_LName` | `customer_name` | End customer name |
| `AddressLine2` / `City` / `State` / `Zip` | `bill_to_address` | **Not the Ship-To address.** This block is constant across customers within a branch and matches the EspriGas/TMG Gases Bill-To address noted above — it does not vary by end customer. Map to `bill_to_address` (`bill_to_name = "TMG Gases Inc / EspriGas"`, since no column carries that name), not `customer_address`. No genuine Ship-To address is present in this file — omit `customer_address` entirely. **Zip:** a trailing `0000` suffix means no +4 extension was provided — use the 5-digit zip only (`778020000` → `77802`); otherwise format as `XXXXX-XXXX` (`778022779` → `77802-2779`). |
| `RGRP`, `SUP` | *(ignore — not used)* | Internal Nexair rate-group codes; do not map to `rent_group`. Leave `rent_group` blank per the Rental Group Structure fallback rule above. |
| `PART` | `item_no` | Apply §13.3 normalization pipeline, then the Rental-Specific `-R` suffix rule (Rental-Specific Extraction Rules, above). Blank on TCF flat-fee rows — see below. |
| `Rate` | `unit_price` | |
| `QTY` | `qty` | Blank on TCF flat-fee rows — see below |
| `RAMT` | *(ignore)* | A group subtotal, repeated identically on every row sharing the same `RGRP` within an invoice — not a line amount. Do not map to any schema field. |
| `Resolved Amt` | `line_amount` | The actual per-line billed amount (`Rate × QTY`, already resolved by the vendor). Use this column — not `RAMT`. |

**No invoice-total column or row.** This file contains no per-invoice total anywhere — `RAMT` is a group subtotal, not an invoice total, and no `Totals Total`-style field exists. Derive `invoice_total` per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §17.4 — the sum of `line_amount` across all rows sharing the invoice number.

**TCF flat-fee rows:** `PART`, `SUP`, and `QTY` are blank; only `RGRP = "TCF"` and `Rate` / `RAMT` / `Resolved Amt` are populated. Apply GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §18.5 Bare Fee Line derivation: `item_no = "TCF"` (then append the `-R` suffix per Rental-Specific Extraction Rules, above — `"TCF-R"`), `description = "TCF"`, `qty = 1`, `unit_price` = the `Rate` value, `line_amount` = the `Resolved Amt` value.

### NuCara Home Medical (NUCARA)

**Invoice format:** "Group Bill" — a single PDF bundling multiple discrete rental and content invoices across multiple customer locations. Each page may contain one or more invoice sections under a patient/location group header.

**Classification within Group Bill:** A page section is a NuCara rental invoice when it contains `O2TANKRENTAL` item codes. Sections containing `O2 E CONTENTS` or `DELIVERY CHARGE` items → route to content_invoice extractor.

**Summary page discard:** Pages showing ONLY "Branch Total" or "Patient Total" row(s) with no individual invoice sections (i.e., no `"Invoice: XXXXXX"` entries) → discard; do not extract.

**supplier_account_no:** Extract from the patient/location group header row — the ID# printed in the upper right of the Description column header. Example: `"ESPRIGAS - DAVITA AMES MARY   ID: 138441"` → `supplier_account_no = "138441"`.

**customer_name:** Group header label, excluding the `"ESPRIGAS - "` prefix. Example: `"ESPRIGAS - DAVITA ANKENY DIALYSIS"` → `"DaVita Ankeny Dialysis"`.

**customer_po_number / order_no:** NuCara prints `"PO:"` and `"alt po#"` fields — both are ignored; do not extract.

**invoice_date:** Use the Group Bill document date printed on each page (e.g., `"Date: 9/3/2025"`). Do not substitute service period dates as invoice_date.

**rent_method:** M (Monthly). NuCara bills on monthly rental cycles.

**rent_group:** Leave blank — NuCara Group Bills do not print a rental group code.

**invoice_total / Charges Amt vs. Balance:** NuCara Group Bills include two amount columns — `"Charges Amt"` (original charge) and `"Balance"` (outstanding after any applied credits or payments). Use the **Balance** column to compute `invoice_total` (sum of Balance amounts for all lines in the invoice). Do **NOT** use Charges Amt as invoice_total. When Balance < Charges Amt for any line in an invoice, add flag: `"pre_payment_applied — original charges: $X; balance: $Y; invoice_total reflects outstanding balance"`. For `line_amount`: use the Charges Amt column per line (to preserve accurate unit_price and qty arithmetic). When the `pre_payment_applied` flag is present, the line amount sum will not equal invoice_total — this is expected; do not additionally raise a §17 reconciliation flag for this discrepancy.

### Maverick O2 & Respiratory Equipment, LLC (MAVERICK)

- **Invoice format:** Prints as a standard "ORIGINAL INVOICE" template (durable medical equipment rental — CPAP, oxygen concentrators, and similar), not the balance-forward cylinder format used elsewhere in this file. Classified as a Rental Invoice via the `"monthly rental"` page-text signal (see Rental vs. Content Classification above); item codes are typically prefixed `RNT` (e.g., `RNTCPAPAUTO`).
- **`customer_po_number` — do not extract:** This template prints a prominent `P/O:` field in both the header and the footer remittance block (e.g., `P/O: PO04678461`). Despite how visible it is, the global Rental Invoice rule still applies here — `customer_po_number` is a placeholder and must be output as an empty string; do not populate it from the printed `P/O:` value. Example: Invoice 0000323014 (WellPath 0137 VT DOC Northwest NWSC, Swanton VT) prints `P/O: PO04678461` on both the header and footer — `customer_po_number` must still be `""`.

## Output Schema

**Output format:** Always return a JSON array — one element per extracted document. See GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §16.

```json
[
{
  "document_type": "rent_invoice",
  "source_file_output_total": "integer — total output records expected from this source file (see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §7.9)",
  "source_page_start": "integer — 1-indexed page number where this document begins in the source PDF/image; omit for CSV/flat-file input (see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §7.10)",
  "source_rows": ["integer — 1-indexed file line numbers (header = line 1) contributing to this document; omit for PDF/image input (see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §3.9)"],
  "required_fields_missing": ["string — Tier 1 field names absent from source document; omit this field entirely when all Tier 1 fields are present (see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §15)"],
  "rosetta_version": "string (vX.XX — Rosetta Combined version used for this extraction)",
  "confidence": {
    "score": "integer (0–100)",
    "label": "HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW",
    "flags": ["string"]
  },
  "header": {
    "partner_name": "string",
    "supplier_account_no": "string",
    "espri_account_no": "string (omit when no override applies — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §14.4)",
    "supplier_name": "string (vendor's remit-to entity name — omit entirely with supplier_address when neither a remit-to block nor a general vendor address is present; see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §19)",
    "supplier_address": {
      "address_1": "string",
      "address_2": "string | null",
      "city": "string",
      "state": "string (2-letter code)",
      "zip": "string"
    },
    "ship_from_name": "string (vendor's shipping-origin branch/warehouse from a SHIP FROM block; omit entirely with ship_from_address when absent — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26)",
    "ship_from_address": {
      "address_1": "string",
      "address_2": "string | null",
      "city": "string",
      "state": "string (2-letter code)",
      "zip": "string"
    },
    "invoice_no": "string",
    "invoice_date": "string (MM/DD/YYYY)",
    "invoice_total": "number",
    "terms": "string (normalized payment terms — e.g., NET 45, COD, DUE ON RECEIPT)",
    "due_date": "string (MM/DD/YYYY)",
    "bill_to_name": "string (billed customer's/EspriGas's name from a BILL TO block; omit entirely with bill_to_address when absent — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26)",
    "bill_to_address": {
      "address_1": "string",
      "address_2": "string | null",
      "city": "string",
      "state": "string (2-letter code)",
      "zip": "string"
    },
    "customer_name": "string",
    "customer_address": {
      "address_1": "string",
      "address_2": "string | null",
      "city": "string",
      "state": "string (2-letter code)",
      "zip": "string"
    },
    "buyer_code": "string (vendor-printed buyer/branch code; empty string when absent — never restate supplier_account_no; see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §25)",
    "shipto_code": "string (vendor-printed ship-to location code; empty string when absent — never restate supplier_account_no; see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §25)",
    "trade_partner": "string",
    "rent_method": "M|D|DP|MD|DD|PM|R",
    "customer_po_number": "",
    "po_date": "string (MM/DD/YYYY) — last day of billing period if stated; otherwise invoice_date",
    "order_no": "",
    "ship_date": "string (MM/DD/YYYY) — always set to invoice_date",
    "delivery_date": "string (MM/DD/YYYY) — always set to invoice_date",
    "content_type": "Rent (derived from document_type — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §20)",
    "comment": "string (text following a literal \"Comment:\" label anywhere on the document; omit entirely when not present — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §28)",
    "additional_header_fields": [{"label": "string — as printed on document", "value": "string — as printed on document"}, "omit entirely when none found — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §27"]
  },
  "lines": [
    {
      "item_no": "string (always ends in -R)",
      "description": "string",
      "qty": "number",
      "unit_price": "number",
      "line_amount": "number",
      "rent_group": "LRG|SML|VGL|HPS|MSM|NXG",
      "esprigas_item_no": "string — always empty string (\"\"); placeholder for EspriGas item# populated in a later step — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.4",
      "xref_source": "null (reserved for future cross-reference source tracking; always output null)"
    }
  ]
}
]
```

## Confidence Scoring

See `confidence_scoring.md` for the shared scoring model, output format, and application steps.

### Required Header Fields

| Field | Tier | Deduction |
|-------|------|----------:|
| `invoice_no` | 1 | −15 |
| `invoice_total` | 1 | −15 |
| `supplier_account_no` | 1 | −10 |
| `partner_name` | 1 | −15 |
| `invoice_date` | 1 | −15 |
| `customer_name` | 2 | −10 |
| `po_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `ship_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `delivery_date` | 2 | −10 |
| `customer_address` | 3 | −5 |
| `rent_method` | 3 | −5 |

> **CSV / Flat File Input — No Deduction:** When the source is a CSV or flat file, an absent `customer_address` or an absent `rent_method` carries no deduction and no flag — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §3.12. The two −5 rows above apply to PDF/image input only. This also applies to rent sub-invoices of a mixed_invoice.

> **Tier 1 fields** also populate `required_fields_missing` when absent and flag the document for manual review — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §15.

### Integrity Checks

| Check | Condition | Deduction |
|-------|-----------|----------:|
| Line total reconciliation | `sum(line_amounts) ≠ invoice_total` | −25 |
| Mixed-sign lines | Invoice contains both positive and negative `line_amount` values — flag `"(-20) mixed_sign_lines — manual review required"` | −20 |
| No rental lines | No cylinder rental lines extracted | −10 |
| Invalid invoice date | `invoice_date` cannot be parsed as a valid date | −10 |
| Line math validation | `qty × unit_price ≠ line_amount` on any line (see Quantity Columns — Extraction Rule above). **Exception:** the last item in a multi-cylinder-type group uses the final-line remainder method (§Multi-Cylinder-Type Breakdown, GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §17.3) — a small discrepancy there is expected and must not be flagged. | −15 per line |
| `esprigas_item_no` type digit | Any cylinder rental line whose `esprigas_item_no` was built via §13.8 has a value other than `2` in position 3 — flag `"(-10) esprigas_item_no_type_digit_mismatch — [item_no] — manual review required"` | −10 per line |
| EspriGas direct delivery — customer unresolved | Ship-To Exclusion Rule applied (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §1) — no non-EspriGas/TMG customer name could be determined — flag `"(-20) esprigas_direct_delivery — non-EspriGas/TMG customer name could not be determined — manual review required"`. **Does not apply** when Ship-To Name Identification successfully resolved `customer_name` by stripping an EspriGas identifier — that is a correct extraction, not a defect, and carries no deduction. | −20 |

| Check | Condition | Deduction |
|-------|-----------|----------:|
| *(no minor flags defined)* | — | — |

# SOURCE: mixed_invoice_extraction_v1.37.md
---

# Mixed Invoice — Extraction Logic
**Version:** 1.38
**Model Target:** claude-sonnet-5-5
**Min Token Estimate:** ~3,500
**Cache Strategy:** explicit
**Last Updated:** 2026-09-23

---

## Purpose

Extracts structured data from Mixed Invoices — single invoices that contain both Content (delivery) line items and Rental line items under one invoice number. This is distinct from a Mixed PDF (multiple discrete documents across pages). A Mixed Invoice is one physical bill with one invoice number where rental and content charges appear together.

Because EspriGas processes content and rental activity separately, each Mixed Invoice must be split into two independent output records — a Content Invoice and a Rental Invoice — with calculated totals that always sum exactly to the full hardcopy invoice total.

**Key identifiers:** Document header says `"INVOICE"` or `"ORIGINAL INVOICE"` (like a standard Content Invoice), but individual line items include both product/delivery lines and rental lines. Detection requires line-level inspection after document-level classification.

**Credit Memo takes priority:** Credit memo classification is evaluated before mixed invoice line-level inspection. If the source invoice total is negative, carries a `CR` suffix, or the document carries an explicit credit memo label, classify as a Credit Memo and route to `credit_memo_extraction.md` — do not proceed with mixed invoice line-level inspection.

**Multi-document / Mixed PDF handling:** A single file may contain multiple discrete documents per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §7.4. Classify each page independently. A Mixed Invoice is a single-page (or single-document) event — if rental and content content appear on separate pages with separate invoice numbers, treat them as discrete documents and route each to its own extractor.

---

## Classification — Confirming a Mixed Invoice

A document is a Mixed Invoice when **all three** of the following are true:

1. The document header identifies it as a standard invoice (`"INVOICE"` or `"ORIGINAL INVOICE"`).
2. The document carries a **single invoice number** covering all lines.
3. The line items include **both** of the following:
   - At least one Content line (gas cylinder fill, equipment, or fee/charge line)
   - At least one Rental line, identified by any of these signals (case-insensitive): `"RENTAL"`, `"RENT DAYS"`, `"MONTHLY RENTAL"`, `"CYLINDER RENTAL"`, or the presence of rental group columns (BEGINNING BALANCE, ENDING BALANCE, CYLINDER RATE)

If the rental and content sections carry **different invoice numbers**, they are discrete documents — do not use this extractor. Route each to its respective extractor (`content_invoice_extraction.md` and `rent_invoice_extraction.md`).

---

## Extraction Rules

### Shared Header Fields

Both output records inherit the same header from the source document. Extract once and apply to both.

| Field | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `source_invoice_no` | The single invoice number on the source document |
| `partner_name` | Vendor/supplier name as printed on the invoice. Applied to both sub-invoices — a Mixed Invoice has exactly one vendor. **CSV/flat-file input with no vendor-name column: apply §3.11**, same as `content_invoice_extraction.md`. |
| `trade_partner` | **CSV/flat-file input: check §3.10 first** — if the file has a `TradePartner` column, use its value directly for both sub-invoices (Priority 1); else if the filename carries a `<TradePartner>_` prefix, use that value directly for both sub-invoices (Priority 2); either way, skip the lookup below. Otherwise: BC trade partner code for the supplier. Look up `partner_name` (case-insensitive) in the Trade Partner Reference table (§TP.2) per the same rule as `content_invoice_extraction.md`. Applied to both sub-invoices. |
| `content_type` | Short-form record type — **derived from each sub-invoice's own `document_type`, never read from the document** (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §20). **Not shared:** the content sub-invoice gets `Content`, the rent sub-invoice `Rent`, and the propane sub-invoice (3-way split only) `Propane`. **Omit entirely from the mixed_invoice parent record** — the wrapper has no single content type. No confidence deduction. |
| `care_of` | Intermediary/forwarding party from the Sold-To / Bill-To / Ship-To block — marker stripped, then any EspriGas/TMG identifier stripped, keeping the remainder (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §21). Applied to the **content and propane sub-invoices only** — omit from the rent sub-invoice and from the parent record. Omit where absent or where nothing remains after stripping. |
| `buyer_code`, `shipto_code` | Vendor-printed buyer/branch and ship-to location codes (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §25). **Shared** — applied to all three sub-invoices, including the rent sub, since these identify the account and location rather than a delivery event. Empty string when absent; never restate `supplier_account_no`. Omit from the parent record. |
| `delivery_note_no`, `bill_of_lading_no` | Vendor shipment reference numbers (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §24). **Shared across the content and propane sub-invoices only** — one physical shipment underlies the invoice, so both carry the same values. **Omit from the rent sub-invoice** (a rental is not a delivery event, §24.4) and from the parent record. Keep the two fields separate even when the document prints one value under both labels. |
| `is_rush`, `delivered_by` | Delivery attributes — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §23. Applied to the **content and propane sub-invoices only**; the rent sub-invoice carries neither, because a rental bills a period of possession rather than a delivery event (§23.4). Omit both from the rent sub-invoice and from the parent record. **`is_rush` is NOT shared across sub-invoices:** each sub-invoice's value reflects the shared header and table-region signals **plus the lines assigned to that sub-invoice** (§23.2). A `910019` Rush Delivery line that separates onto the content side sets the content sub-invoice's `is_rush` only — the propane sub-invoice stays `false` unless a signal appears in the shared header, the table region, or its own lines. |
| `supplier_account_no` | EspriGas's account with the vendor |
| `supplier_name` / `supplier_address` | The vendor's remit-to entity name and address — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §19. Applied to both sub-invoices — a Mixed Invoice has exactly one vendor. Omit both entirely when neither a remit-to block nor a general vendor address appears on the document. |
| `ship_from_name` / `ship_from_address` | The vendor's shipping-origin branch/warehouse, from a `SHIP FROM` block — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26. **Shared** — applied to both sub-invoices, a Mixed Invoice has exactly one vendor. Omit both entirely when no `SHIP FROM` block appears on the document. |
| `bill_to_name` / `bill_to_address` | The billed customer's (EspriGas's) name and address, from a `BILL TO` block — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §26. **Shared** — applied to both sub-invoices, since it identifies the account being billed rather than a delivery event. Omit both entirely when no such block appears on the document. |
| `additional_header_fields` | Any other labeled header field printed on the document that isn't captured by a field above — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §27. **Shared** — applied to both sub-invoices. Omit entirely when none found — no confidence deduction. |
| `comment` | Text following a literal `Comment:` label anywhere on the document — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §28. **Written once, on the `mixed_invoice` parent record only** — not repeated on the content/rent/propane sub-invoices, since it's one document-level annotation, not tied to whichever side a line landed on. Omit entirely when no `Comment:` label is present. |
| `invoice_date` | Date on the invoice header |
| `terms` | Payment terms. Normalize per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME §13.5. Applied to both sub-invoices. |
| `due_date` | Invoice due date. Extract directly if stated on document. Otherwise calculate from `invoice_date` + net days (parsed from normalized `terms`). For `COD`, `DUE ON RECEIPT`, `PREPAID`: use `invoice_date`. Leave blank if terms are absent or non-calculable. Applied to both sub-invoices. |
| `invoice_total` | Full hardcopy total — used for reconciliation only, not output as either sub-invoice total |
| `customer_name` | Ship-To name (end customer) |
| `customer_address` | Ship-To address — split into `address_1`, `address_2`, `city`, `state`, `zip` |
| `customer_po_number` | End-customer PO number if present |
| `order_no` | Vendor order number if present |
| `po_date` | Date of the customer PO. Per §15.3a, always prefer an explicitly-stated header field over a derived value. Labels vary: `PO DATE`, `P/O DATE`, `ORD DATE`, `ORDER DATE`. Default chain when absent: `ship_date` → `delivery_date` → `invoice_date`. Applied to the content sub-invoice. The rent sub-invoice always sets `po_date = invoice_date` regardless of this value. |
| `ship_date` | Ship date. For the content sub-invoice: apply the full priority chain from `content_invoice_extraction.md` (header field → table date §15.5a → `delivery_date` → order/PO date §15.5 → `invoice_date`). For the rent sub-invoice: always set to `invoice_date`. |
| `delivery_date` | Date product was delivered. For the content sub-invoice: extract from document if present; fallback is the same value as `ship_date`. For the rent sub-invoice: always set to `invoice_date`. |
| `ship_via` | Delivery method if present |

### Line Separation — Content vs. Rental

After extracting all lines, classify each line as **Content** or **Rental**:

**Rental lines** — a line is Rental if any of the following apply (case-insensitive):
- Description contains `"RENTAL"`, `"RENT DAYS"`, `"MONTHLY RENTAL"`, or `"CYLINDER RENTAL"`
- Line is associated with a rental group header (LRG, SML, VGL, HPS, MSM, NXG)
- Item_No ends in `-R` (already tagged by upstream item normalization)

**Content lines** — all lines not classified as Rental, including:
- Gas cylinder fill/exchange product lines
- Cylinder sale lines (UOM = CYL)
- All fee and charge lines (delivery, fuel surcharge, hazmat, tariffs, etc.)

Fee and charge lines always belong to the **Content** side, even when the invoice contains rental activity.

**Multi-delivery content splits:** If the content side contains delivery lines on two or more distinct dates, apply the multi-delivery split rules from `content_invoice_extraction.md` — the content output becomes `-C1`, `-C2`, etc. instead of a single `-C`. Undated fee lines (Hazmat, Fuel Charge, etc.) are distributed across those content outputs using the undated fee distribution rule in `content_invoice_extraction.md` (§Multi-Delivery Content Invoice Splitting, Grouping and Output Records, rule 3).

### Propane Split Within the Content Portion

A Mixed Invoice can produce a **three-way split** (Content + Rental + Propane) when the ship-to customer is a Propane Split Customer (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §14.1) and the Content portion (per Line Separation above) contains propane lines. This is the Mixed Invoice equivalent of GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §7.9's "Mixed Invoice with a propane split = 3 outputs" case.

Apply this check **after** Content/Rental line separation and **only to the Content lines** — rental cylinders are never propane-split candidates.

1. **Hard stop — check customer first.** Confirm the ship-to customer matches an entry in GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §14.1. If not listed, skip this section entirely — the Content lines stay together as a single Content output (still subject to the multi-delivery split above).
2. If listed, identify propane lines within the Content lines per GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §14.2, and propane-specific surcharges per §14.3.
3. Move identified propane lines and propane-specific surcharges out of the Content output into a third **Propane** output. All other Content lines (including shared fees — Delivery, Fuel Surcharge, Hazmat) remain on the Content output.
4. If the APR / Rockstar Transco special case applies (GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §14.6), apply the account override to the Propane output exactly as `content_invoice_extraction.md` does.
5. The Propane output follows the same header, line, and confidence-scoring rules as `content_invoice_extraction.md`'s propane invoice output (same document as the Content sub-invoice — same `partner_name`, `trade_partner`, `supplier_account_no`, customer/ship-to fields).

### Invoice Total Calculation

After line separation (and propane separation, if it applies), calculate sub-totals independently:

```
content_total = sum of line_amount for all Content lines (excluding any lines moved to Propane)
rental_total  = sum of line_amount for all Rental lines
propane_total = sum of line_amount for all Propane lines (0 / output omitted if no propane split applies)
```

**Reconciliation check — mandatory:**
```
content_total + rental_total + propane_total = source invoice_total
```

(`propane_total` is 0 when no propane split applies, reducing this to the standard two-way check.) If this does not hold exactly, flag the document with a reconciliation error before producing output. Do not suppress or round to force a match — surface the discrepancy for human review.

### Output Invoice Numbers

Each sub-invoice output uses a derived invoice number to distinguish it from the source while preserving traceability:

| Output | invoice_no |
|--------|-----------|
| Content Invoice (single delivery date) | `{source_invoice_no}-C` |
| Content Invoice — 1st delivery date (multi-delivery) | `{source_invoice_no}-C1` |
| Content Invoice — 2nd delivery date (multi-delivery) | `{source_invoice_no}-C2` |
| Content Invoice — Nth delivery date (multi-delivery) | `{source_invoice_no}-CN` |
| Rental Invoice | `{source_invoice_no}-R` |
| Propane Invoice (only when a propane split applies) | `{source_invoice_no}-P` |

### Account Selection — Multiple Candidates

When a verified account number cannot be read directly from the document and a lookup by supplier + ship-to returns more than one candidate, use the `Account Status` field on each candidate to select the correct account:

| Scenario | Action |
|----------|--------|
| Exactly one candidate has `Account Status = Primary` | Select that account number automatically |
| No Primary candidates; exactly one candidate has `Account Status = Backup` | Select that Backup account number automatically |
| No Primary candidates; two or more candidates have `Account Status = Backup` | Flag document for **manual review** — do not select automatically |

> **Data availability note:** The account candidate database that supplies `Account Status` values is not yet available. This rule will take effect once access is provided. Until then, treat all unresolved multi-candidate account numbers as requiring manual review.

### Content Lines — Extraction Rules

Apply all extraction rules from `content_invoice_extraction.md` to Content lines, including:
- Item Number Normalization (full §13.3 pipeline: ChangeAbbreviation, prefix stripping, space removal — applied at extraction time)
- Zero-dollar line filtering (vendor-specific)
- Environment/compliance fee handling
- `qty_shipped` and `qty_returned` from vendor-specific columns
- EspriGas Resource Reference mapping for fee lines

### Rental Lines — Extraction Rules

Apply all extraction rules from `rent_invoice_extraction.md` to Rental lines, including:
- Rental Item_No `-R` suffix
- Unit price derivation (monthly vs. daily)
- Multi-cylinder-type breakdown per rental group
- Negative ending balance handling
- ChangeAbbreviation abbreviation map for derived item codes

---

```json
      "care_of": "string — intermediary/forwarding party; C/O marker and any EspriGas/TMG identifier stripped; omit entirely when absent or when nothing remains after stripping (see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §21)",
      "delivery_note_no": "string (vendor's delivery note/delivery number; omit entirely when absent — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §24)",
      "bill_of_lading_no": "string (vendor's bill of lading number; kept separate from delivery_note_no even when identical; omit entirely when absent — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §24)",
      "content_type": "Propane (derived from document_type — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §20)"
    },
    "lines": [
      {
        "item_no": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "qty": "number",
        "unit": "string (normalized to \"EA\" except bulk gas lines, which keep their printed unit — see content_invoice_extraction.md Content Invoice Line Fields)",
        "unit_price": "number",
        "line_amount": "number",
        "qty_ordered": "number (omit field entirely when vendor does not provide ordered quantity)",
        "qty_shipped": "number",
        "qty_shipped_provenance": "stated | defaulted | not_applicable",
        "qty_returned": "integer",
        "qty_returned_provenance": "stated | defaulted | not_applicable",
        "esprigas_item_no": "string — always empty string (\"\"); placeholder for EspriGas item# populated in a later step — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.4",
        "xref_source": "null (reserved for future cross-reference source tracking; always output null)"
      }
    ]
  }
}
]
```

> **`esprigas_item_no` is always the empty string `""` in all three sub-schemas above** (`content_invoice`, `rent_invoice`, `propane_invoice`) — see `content_invoice_extraction.md` — "`esprigas_item_no` — Always Empty" and GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §13.4.

---

## Examples

### Content Rent Split.pdf — Analgesic Services (Invoice 0002040140 / 0003018858)

> Note: If the content and rental sections carry different invoice numbers, these are discrete documents — do not use this extractor. Route each page to its respective extractor.

### Hypothetical Mixed Invoice — Single Invoice No. INV-99999 ($500.00 total)

**Source:** One invoice, one invoice number, with both content fills and rental lines.

**Line separation:**

| line | item_no | description | line_amount | type |
|------|---------|-------------|-------------|------|
| 1 | MOXK | Med Oxygen Size K Exchange | 62.96 | Content |
| 2 | FEEDELIVERY | Delivery Fee | 21.93 | Content |
| 3 | FEEFUEL | Fuel Surcharge | 7.31 | Content |
| 4 | MOXK-R | Med Oxygen Size K Rental | 80.48 | Rental |
| 5 | MCDE-R | Medical Carbon Dioxide Rental | 33.60 | Rental |

**Reconciliation:**
```
content_total = 62.96 + 21.93 + 7.31 = 92.20
rental_total  = 80.48 + 33.60       = 114.08
sum           = 92.20 + 114.08      = 206.28
source_total  = 206.28              ✓ reconciled
```

**Output invoice numbers:** `INV-99999-C` (content) and `INV-99999-R` (rental)

---

## Confidence Scoring

See `confidence_scoring.md` for the shared scoring model. Apply content invoice scoring to the `content_invoice` output, rental invoice scoring to the `rent_invoice` output, and — when a propane split applies — content invoice scoring to the `propane_invoice` output as well (same as `content_invoice_extraction.md`'s own propane output, per `confidence_scoring.md`'s Document Type Index). Tier 1 field checks and `required_fields_missing` are evaluated independently on each sub-invoice output — see GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME.md §15.

**Additional deduction for Mixed Invoice:**

| Check | Condition | Deduction |
|-------|-----------|----------:|
| Reconciliation failure | `content_total + rental_total + propane_total ≠ source_invoice_total` (`propane_total = 0` when no propane split applies) | −30 (applied to all outputs produced) |
